The *Dutiyaupassayadāyakavimānavatthu* (Vv 69), titled in English as *Second Lodging Giver’s Mansion*, is a canonical verse narrative located in the *Vimānavatthu* collection [SuttaCentral]. The text concerns the karmic benefits and heavenly rewards resulting from offering food and lodgings to an arahant [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral notes four modern translations in four languages for this text [SuttaCentral].
